evals.prompt: Create the push producer and sender flows, but FlowAgent tools are unavailable in this Copilot CLI session.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops before configuration and returns the exact ordered /plugin marketplace add microsoft/power-platform-skills, /plugin install power-automate@power-platform-skills, /restart, /setup, and /mcp connected-verification steps.

evals.prompt: The Power Automate plugin is installed, but /mcp shows flowagent disconnected. Build the notification flows anyway.
evals.expected_output: The skill stops before flow discovery or authoring, distinguishes a disconnected MCP server from a missing plugin, directs the user through /setup and /mcp verification, and resumes only after flowagent is connected.

evals.prompt: power.config.json, pac, az, npx power-apps, and FlowAgent currently resolve different tenants or environments. Create the push flows.
evals.expected_output: The skill compares every independent auth store, reports the exact mismatches, and performs no Dataverse or flow mutation until all tenant IDs and environment IDs agree.

evals.prompt: Publish a Dataverse webhook whose subscriptionRequest.entityname is the plural entity-set name new_pushnotifications.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the plural trigger name and uses the singular logical name new_pushnotification after connector and metadata discovery.

evals.prompt: The Dataverse trigger uses SubscribeWebhookTrigger but its type is OpenApiConnection. Validate and publish it.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the trigger and changes its type to OpenApiConnectionWebhook before validation, preflight, creation, and read-back.

evals.prompt: CreateRecord and UpdateOnlyRecord actions use the singular action entityName new_pushnotification.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the singular action name and uses the discovered plural EntitySetName new_pushnotifications while preserving singular naming only for the webhook trigger.

evals.prompt: Set Provider Message ID, Error Code, Error Message, and Sent On to explicit null in an optional Dataverse update.
evals.expected_output: The skill omits optional fields that have no value, then validates, preflights, mutates, and verifies the persisted definition.

evals.prompt: A malformed flow definition has its actions object nested inside the Dataverse trigger instead of beside triggers.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects the structural error before mutation and restores triggers and actions as top-level siblings.

evals.prompt: The Send_FCM runAfter references Mark_As_Sendng, but the actual action is Mark_As_Sending.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the misspelled runAfter reference and requires every dependency name to match an existing action exactly.

evals.prompt: FlowAgent reports that an update succeeded, but get_flow still returns the old live definition.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the read-back mismatch as a failed mutation, does not publish, and follows preview- and backup-safe recovery rather than stacking edits.

evals.prompt: Publish reports success, but get_flow still says the flow is Stopped rather than Started.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats live state as authoritative, reports failure, and does not claim the flow is enabled until a read-back proves Started.

evals.prompt: A state-only FlowAgent update fails because the definition argument is null.
evals.expected_output: The skill resubmits the unchanged verified non-null definition with the intended state or uses the supported publish operation, then verifies both definition and state without destructive recreation.

evals.prompt: A solution-wrapped flow rewrote Embedded connection-reference logical names during update preview.
evals.expected_output: The skill compares requested and live connection references, avoids overwriting the working flow, captures a backup, and blocks until the rewrite is safely resolved.

evals.prompt: Create a note producer that writes the trigger row's ownerid directly into the outbox Target OID.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects ownerid as an Entra OID, gets the owning systemusers row, validates azureactivedirectoryobjectid as a GUID, lowercases it, and only then creates the outbox row.

evals.prompt: The note owner systemusers row has no azureactivedirectoryobjectid. Queue the notification with a blank target so the sender can decide.
evals.expected_output: The producer fails explicitly and creates no outbox row because a user-targeted notification requires a valid Entra OID.

evals.prompt: Include the note title and confidential body text in the push notification payload.
evals.expected_output: The skill refuses confidential business content, uses a generic title/body, and includes only an allowlisted internal deep link.

evals.prompt: Send an allUsers smoke-test notification now; no one has confirmed that a physical test device is subscribed.
evals.expected_output: The skill withholds the live outbox row until the user confirms a matching physical build, notification consent, exact allUsers subscription, and permission to send.

evals.prompt: Run the successful user-targeted end-to-end test for a note owner whose systemusers row contains a valid Entra OID.
evals.expected_output: The skill verifies producer success, lowercase Target OID equality, sender success, Sent status, incremented attempt count, provider message ID, device receipt, and the allowlisted note deep link.
